title: Senusret I
summary: King listed in CFAH-7A Table 3 (Egypt Dynasty 12).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 12. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-7A (Table 3, "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 12").

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (CFAH non-anchor dates). No tier 1–4 birth year. The year is the reign-start figure already printed on dates.reign: Start: 1686; End: 1655. Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-11-13): was none.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7B: Kings of Dynasties 1-13," OSF preprint v1.3 (10 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/TUWNC, file CFAH 7-B Kings of Dynasties 1-13_v_1.3.pdf, Table 15 "EKL Solution Dynasties 4, 11, 12, 6", p. 103
reign.note: Row "EKL #15 Saophis I = Senusret I" of Table 15 (Egypt (Eratosthenes King List, EKL)).

reign.date: Start Co-Rex: 1729 & 1718; Start Sole-rex: 1708; End Sole-rex: 1686/1685; Death or Deposition: 1683
